name: A. James "Jim" Teague

career.title: Various roles over 22 years, including Vice President of Hydrocarbon Feedstocks

career.organization: Tejas Natural Gas Liquids, LLC (Shell affiliate)
career.title: President
Executive Vice President (also Chief Commercial Officer 2008-2010; director since 2008)

background_rationale: A career commercial and operating executive in hydrocarbons, he ran feedstocks at Dow and marketing and trading at MAPCO, then served as Enterprise's chief commercial officer and chief operating officer before becoming CEO, overseeing commercial, operations and engineering as co-CEO.

notable.summary: On Teague's recommendation, Enterprise moved to a co-CEO model, with Teague, CEO since January 2016, sharing the top job with CFO Randy Fowler.
Enterprise completed its $3.2 billion acquisition of Navitas Midstream, which Teague described as an entry point for its gas processing and NGL businesses in the Midland Basin.
Enterprise acquired Pinon Midstream, a gathering and treating system in the Delaware Basin, for $949 million.
Teague announced he will retire on Jan. 4, 2027, after 28 years at Enterprise, with co-CEO Randy Fowler set to become sole CEO.

personal_story.hook: Jim Teague spent 22 years at Dow Chemical before joining Enterprise in 1999; he has led it since 2016.
personal_story.summary: Little about Teague's early life or education is public. He spent 22 years at Dow Chemical, rising to vice president of hydrocarbon feedstocks, a role he says let him travel extensively around the world. He then ran marketing and trading at MAPCO and led Shell affiliate Tejas Natural Gas Liquids, and came to Enterprise in 1999 when it bought midstream assets from Shell affiliates. At Enterprise he served as chief commercial officer and chief operating officer before becoming CEO in 2016 and co-CEO in 2020; he plans to retire on Jan. 4, 2027.
